flaconi | Germany / Berlin | Full Time | https://www.flaconi.de | e-commerce

flaconi is an online e-commerce for beauty products, founded in 2011 in Berlin. We are active in 12 countries and expanding to more. We're primarily on AWS, use React, Next.js, Vercel for web, Flutter for our mobile app - you will find more details on the job listings. For exceptional candidates, visa sponsorship is also a possibility.

We do hybrid, but fully remote is also a possibility within Germany.

1. Staff Software Engineer - Frontend - €85.000 - €105.000 EUR - https://grnh.se/kke6q552teu - we will very likely work together. Happy to answer questions.

2. QA Engineer Mobile - €60.000 - €83.000 EUR - https://grnh.se/ad3i2y62teu
